actual_scope: User-assigned representation search for kappa=1/100: test signed powers of five modulo powers of two, with a fully paid binary-input/binary-output conversion boundary; analyze reduced output precision and one independent block-table pivot.
scope_change_reason: The donor explicitly requests a structural change and sets 0.01 as the first milestone, with 0.1 and 0.5 as stretch goals. This replaces weighted allocation and does not extend the selected finite circuit.
bottleneck_link: Changing multiplication into exponent addition helps only when both input conversions, output decoding, constant preparation and tape work fit O(n (log n)^0.99). Establish whether precision truncation or independent digit tables can supply that missing saving.
stop_rule: Prove/test the full algebra first; test exact collisions for a shortened encoded product, then one bounded block-table pivot. Stop these implementations on a scoped failure; do not scale an unchanged search or assert a new kappa without a complete conversion cost proof.
evidence: RESULT.json and six passing mathematical/behavioral groups: a complete exact unsigned codec, 1,020 unit round trips, 21,844 exhaustive small full products, 250 collision fixtures with one-bit repairs, and the sharp independent-block precision boundary with corrected low-dependent positive controls.
author: David (sandersdavid90-droid), with OpenAI Codex assistance

open_questions.question: Can a fused or dependent conversion implement the full-precision product encoding and binary decode within O(n (log n)^0.99)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The additive core is linear, but omitted conversion work can contain the complete multiplication problem.
open_questions.first_step: Specify a new coupled conversion interface with all intermediate bit volumes and a complete recurrence; show how it handles the supplied collision and mixed-block fixtures.
open_questions.blocked_by: No favorable complete conversion construction is currently supplied.

optimistic_budget: Two encodings at product precision plus one decoding, fixed-base constant preparation and O(n) valuation, addition, movement and output. For a fused variant replace this sum by its actual complete cost, never zero out unknown conversion work.
family_decision: Stop shortened exponent-sum-only reading, its stated sum/low-bit augmentation, and independent additive block conversion for this canonical code. Do not expand their implementation. General full-precision dependent/shared or fused conversion remains open; no kappa improvement.
overlap: Targeted live GitHub PR-body searches for discrete logarithm, logarithmic representation and Sophie yielded no match. Earlier 2-adic hits concern decoder valuations rather than multiplicative number encoding. Read current discussion hubs and board; local helper covered only 8 sparse records and had no cached remote snapshot. This is limited coverage, not a novelty claim. Previous upstream write attempts returned 403; use an accessible fork artifact for publication.
method: Classical principal-unit group and 2-adic valuation identities; explicit polynomial product collisions; exact mixed finite difference; separately coded power enumeration and residue checks.
bounded_pivot: Independent additive lookup tables on a binary block cut. They work up to precision k+2 and fail at k+3; a low-dependent correction is exact but has no favorable complete cost proof.
claim_scope: Written universal statements have precisely specified reader/table hypotheses. Finite replay supports those proofs. No general representation or integer-multiplication lower bound, no fast-conversion theorem and no new kappa.
